picks.thesis: Big-name good-news gap: a large cash-flow beat and a strong cloud forecast (AI spending paying off) put MSFT ~+3.6% premarket while Alphabet sank on the same theme. Megacap rule: good-news gaps paid over 5-10 days, enter only above VWAP. Only buys if a slot frees up (3 positions open). Wrong if it closes below Wednesday's ~$527 close (gap filled).
